nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_0
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Set references to owning character when this blueprint initializes.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_1
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Only update values if the character is valid (character exists in the world and the reference is set).

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_2
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Set velocity and ground speed from the movement components velocity. Ground speed is calculated from only the X and Y axis of the velocity, so moving up or down does not affect it.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_3
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Set Should Move to true only if ground speed is above a small threshold (to prevent incredibly small velocities from triggering animations) and if there is currently acceleration (input) applied.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_4
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Set Is Falling from the movement components falling state.
